A small space to play with music.space play / pause

A few notes to get started.

Each column is a moment in time. Each row is a note in your chosen scale.

  1. Tap a square to add or remove a note. Drag across the grid to draw.
  2. Press Play loop, or use the space bar. The loop repeats every four beats.
  3. Change the key or scale to hear the same pattern in a new way.
  4. Export WAV for audio, or MIDI to keep working in your music software.

Notes stay on this page until you reload. Export a loop to keep it. Playback pauses when you leave the tab.
